verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ubuntu's desktop shells (Unity's Dash/HUD, later GNOME) have long featured a global 'type to search' launcher for apps and settings, and the transition to GNOME kept a similar experience. However, evidence is historical/community-only (no first-party docs on the current GNOME search launcher) and includes a concrete usability gripe about search ranking accuracy (e.g. 'calc' resolving to LibreOffice Calc instead of Calculator). missing for 10: first-party documentation of the current GNOME Activities/search launcher, evidence of unified file+app+settings search quality, and confirmation the ranking issue was resolved.
